text.aria-label: Title text 'Event-free windows: C1 (grey) and C2 (orange) on 14 days with no labelled or verified load-shift within 7 days The two bands lie on top of each other while the gate is off. Black: observed power. Window rule: the lowest-numbered Primary of the group whose 14 days starting on day 8 of the month hold no event.'
text.tspan: Event-free windows: C1 (grey) and C2 (orange) on 14 days with no labelled or verified load-shift within 7 days
The two bands lie on top of each other while the gate is off. Black: observed power. Window rule: the lowest-numbered Primary of the group whose 14 days starting on day 8 of the month hold no event.
